dir.description: The directory from which Vitest scans for test files (the `--dir <path>` command line option), resolved against the project root. The project root is Stryker's sandbox directory and is not user-configurable.

related.description: Use [related mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/cli.html#vitest-related) to narrow down the tests to run

configFile.description: Path to the config file. Default resolving to `vitest.config.*`, `vite.config.*`
